You e"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"xplicitly grant access to your data (directories, note libraries, local databases), and the AI works"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" deterministically inside the permission ceiling you define."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Currently at **v0.12.0**, targeting local users first — local data lives on your machine, aflare is "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the deterministic and secure control layer between AI and that data."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Key Features"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Local-first, data stays local** — single binary, zero runtime deps, ~10–30MB RAM; workflows, his"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"tory, memory and secrets all stay on local disk; fully offline-capable; no usage telemetry.
- **Conn"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ect your own LLM** — Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; loopback needs no A"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"PI key; without an LLM, keyword matching keeps everything working offline. Multi-provider routing cu"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ts spend and avoids lock-in: one OpenRouter endpoint for every vendor's models, or the native `llm_r"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"outer` node routing by cost / latency with automatic fallback. See LLM Routing.
- **Local data & API"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" connectors** — named, explicitly-authorized connectors for directories, databases and HTTP APIs (`f"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"iles` / `notes` / `sqlite` / `mysql` / `postgres` / `http`); credentials live only in the secrets st"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ore, permission ceilings can be tightened but never loosened. See Connector API.
- **Deterministic r"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"untime** — DAG parallel scheduling (TLA+ formally verified), WAL crash recovery + `--resume`, Saga t"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ransaction compensation, idempotency, retry / rate limit / circuit breaker. Every operation is trace"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"able, replayable, verifiable.
- **Dual Agent + Workflow mode** — conversational ReAct Agent (`aflare"},{"id":"p24s13","text":" chat`) and daemon Agent (`aflare agent`) share one core; 6 pluggable capabilities (reflection / hum"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"an-in-the-loop / utility / memory / planning / workflow).
- **Agent interconnection & commanding** —"},{"id":"p24s15","text":" aflare directs and supervises other agents: CLI channel (`codex` / `claude` / `gemini` or any gener"},{"id":"p24s16","text":"ic CLI) and A2A protocol channel, with real delegation via the `supervisor` node and failure isolati"},{"id":"p24s17","text":"on per agent.
- **Security built in** — HMAC tamper-evident audit chain, AES-GCM encrypted secrets, "},{"id":"p24s18","text":"automatic secret redaction, SSRF / path-traversal / command-injection defenses, outbound anomaly mon"},{"id":"p24s19","text":"itoring + auto circuit-break, four security levels (L0–L3).
- **Extensible ecosystem** — MCP Server "},{"id":"p24s20","text":"/ Client, custom nodes in Go, community plugins, GitHub Action for CI, 30+ built-in LLM providers, O"},{"id":"p24s21","text":"penClaw plugin for the OpenClaw ecosystem.
